events.title: Mana On Tap – Magic The Gathering: Commander Game Night
events.description:
MANA ON TAP: MAGIC THE GATHERING COMMANDER NIGHT
Ready to tap lands, cast spells, and put your Commander deck to the test? Join us every Tuesday night at 3 Daughters Brewing for Mana on Tap, our weekly Magic: The Gathering Commander game night!
Whether you’re a seasoned Planeswalker, a competitive Commander player, or just getting started in the world of Magic, everyone is welcome to pull up a chair, shuffle their deck, and join the fun. Bring your favorite Commander deck, meet fellow players, make new friends, and enjoy an evening of friendly competition, strategy, and great company. There will also be opportunities to enter a raffle for a chance to win booster packs!
Where: The Nook at 3 Daughters Brewing
When: Every Tuesday
Time: 6 PM – 10 PM
Grab a drink, gather your cards, and get ready for a night of epic battles and unforgettable plays. There’s no better way to spend a Tuesday than with good people, great brews, and a little Magic!
Bring your deck. Grab a drink. Let the games begin!
We can’t wait to see you at the table!

events.title: That’s My Jam – Music Trivia
events.description:
Now at 3 Daughters every Tuesday at 6:30 pm!
 THAT’S MY JAM 
A fast-paced, name-that-tune style game with a fun twist!
 Our host will play 20 short song snippets, just 5–7 seconds each.
 After each clip, players write down the song title, the artist, or both.
 Scoring is simple:
• Get the song OR artist right = 1 point
• Get both right = 2 points
 Once all clips are played, our host reveals the answers with a 15–20 second highlight of each song so everyone can jam along!
 The player with the most points gets to head on stage …dance, sing, vibe, and win a prize!

events.title: 100 People Said Game Night
events.description:
Now at 3 Daughters every Sunday at 5 pm!
 100 PEOPLE SAID 
Get ready for a crowd-powered guessing game where your goal is simple: think like the people of Tampa Bay!
 We ask fun survey-style questions like:
• “What’s the best Tom Cruise movie of all time?”
• “Which fast-food place has the best pizza delivery?”
…and many more!
 We’ve collected answers from real people all across Tampa Bay, and your job is to guess the most popular responses.
 Scoring is easy:
 1st most popular answer = 4 points
 2nd most popular = 3 points
 3rd most popular = 2 points
 4th most popular = 1 point
 Whoever racks up the most points by the end of the round wins!
 And the best part? There’s no way to cheat online, our answers come straight from live surveys, so anything can happen!

events.title: Chas Collins
events.description:
3 DAUGHTERS BREWING — GET READY FOR A COUNTRY/ROCK TAKEOVER!
St. Petersburg, Fl get ready! On November 28th, Three Daughters Brewing turns up the volume as Chas Collins, Nashville Rising Star for 2026 and Josie Music Awards winner, brings his high-energy country rock show to the stage!
This is ALL GAS. NO BRAKES. A hard-driving blend of Originals, plus country favorites, rock anthems, and the kind of live performance that takes a party to another level. When Chas and the band hit the stage, the energy builds, the crowd gets louder, and the night becomes anything but ordinary.
With Nashville recognition and a sound that reaches well beyond the local scene, Chas Collins delivers the kind of show you come out to experience live. Expect big music, big energy, and a crowd ready to make some noise.
3 Daughters Brewing | St. Petersburg, Florida
Saturday, November 28th
Show starts at 8 PM
St. Pete, bring your crew and bring your energy. This is not a sit-back-and-watch kind of night.
ALL GAS. NO BRAKES. BE THERE!

events.title: Frogman Feast
events.description:
We’re proud to welcome back the Annual Frogman Feast to 3 Daughters Brewing on Sunday, November 29th from 2-5pm!
This special event brings together approximately 20 award-winning chefs for an unforgettable culinary experience, all in support of the Tampa Bay Frogman Swim and Navy SEAL Foundation.
Guests can enjoy incredible food, drinks, live entertainment, a silent auction, and raffle, all while giving back to the brave men and women who serve our country and the families who stand behind them.
We’re honored to be part of an event that celebrates community, generosity, and those who have sacrificed so much.
Come out, enjoy an amazing afternoon with great food, great company and support an incredible cause.

events.title: SOLD OUT! Fused Glass Creations: Holiday Edition
events.description:
Looking for that special, magical ornament for your tree or a handmade gift that truly stands out?
Join artist Maureen Smith of The O’Dea Collection for a Fused Glass Holiday Workshop at 3 Daughters Brewing on Tuesday, December 1 at 6:30 PM.
During this hands-on, beginner-friendly class, Maureen will guide you step-by-step as you create three unique winter- or holiday-themed pieces — think ornaments, earrings, necklaces, or small dishes. You’ll have plenty of freedom to play with color, texture, and design, making each piece entirely your own.
No experience? No problem! Maureen loves helping creativity come to life — even for those who believe they “aren’t artistic.” All supplies are included; just bring your imagination (and maybe a friend or two!).
Children ages 8+ are welcome with an accompanying adult.
After the class, Maureen will take your creations home to fire them in her kiln, ensuring they’re beautifully finished and ready to shine. Once they’re complete, you can schedule a convenient pickup or meet-up time — either back at 3 Daughters Brewing (the perfect excuse for another pint!) or at another agreed location. Pickup details will be arranged together during the event.
Come enjoy a fun and relaxing evening of creativity and community at one of St. Pete’s favorite local spots. Food and craft beer will be available for purchase from 3 Daughters Brewing.
3 Daughters Brewing
222 22nd Street South, St. Petersburg, FL
Tickets:
$45 per person — includes all materials, instruction, kiln firing, and your finished creations (three pieces total). You can purchase tickets via the link here: https://www.simpletix.com/…/fused-glass-creations-at-3…. Seats are limited — save your spot and join the fun!
No refunds. All sales are final.

events.title: Boots & Brews Country Line Dancing
events.description:
Join us on the first Thursday of every month at 7 PM for a great night of Boots and Brews at 3 Daughters Brewery.
Instructor Kate has been teaching country line dancing for 6+ years for both partner and individual dance lessons and is bringing her expertise to the brewery!
She will be teaching lessons as the DJ plays an array of fun music like, “Beer Money”, “Drinkin’ Beer”, “I Like Beer”, “Beers Ago”, “Beer for my Horses” and dozens of other beer drinking country songs!
So let’s do it! Round up the crew and come get your county dance on!
This is a free event, open to all ages.

events.title: Musical Bingo Nation
events.description:
Join us for Musical Bingo at 3 Daughters Brewing
Free To Play
Win Prizes
Fun For Everyone
Musical Bingo Nation is an entertainment company that provides musical bingo events throughout Florida & New England. With over 30 music rounds, you will always have a new one to try. We play the best music from the Billboard charts, the most identifiable part of each song & the clean versions.
Our goal is to consistently provide a fun, friendly & exciting environment while playing great music for you to enjoy!
If you love music bring your friends & family for the best way to ever play Bingo!
Musical Bingo is a game with the same concept as traditional bingo but instead of letters and numbers, they are replaced with song titles & artists. Players compete to win based on their knowledge of music and the unpredictability of the game. Mark your card when the DJ plays your song!
How To Play
– Look over the songs on your card
– The host will announce when the music round is starting
– Your job is to listen to what songs are playing. If you see that
song on your card, cross off the square
– Fill out 5 in a row (vertical, horizontal, diagonal), and yell BINGO!!
For more information check out our website:
www.MusicalBingoNation.com
